original_ai_output.title_zh: 埃多州推出建筑项目监测平台
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚埃多州政府推出数字化平台EdoBuild360，用于监测建筑项目并评估政府所有建筑的状况。该平台可提供建筑数字记录，覆盖从规划、执行到竣工的施工项目监测。据州长建筑项目监测与实施特别顾问Irene Ojo介绍，该平台由她的办公室与多家政府机构合作开发，还将提供建筑安全信息。目前信息来自单一来源报道。

key_facts.fact: 埃多州政府推出数字化平台EdoBuild360用于监测建筑项目
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Edo State Government on Wednesday launched a digital platform, EdoBuild360, for monitoring building projects and assessing the condition of government-owned buildings across the state.

key_facts.fact: 该平台提供建筑数字记录并覆盖从规划到竣工的项目监测
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The platform is designed to provide digital records of buildings and enable the monitoring of construction projects, from planning and execution to completion.

key_facts.fact: 平台由州长特别顾问办公室与多家政府机构合作开发
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the Special Adviser to Governor Monday Okpebholo on Building Projects Monitoring and Implementation, Irene Ojo, said her office developed the initiative in partnership with government agencies

uncertainties: 目前仅一个来源（Punch）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
